modernmusic.cache.title: Cache
modernmusic.cache.size: Audio and artwork memory: about %s MiB
modernmusic.cache.help: Stops local playback, cancels song and playlist loading, and releases audio, lyrics and covers. Only you are muted in a room. Queues, HUD layout and login are kept. Original local and server audio files are kept.
modernmusic.cache.done: Cache cleared. Return and press play, or resume listening on the room page. Covers reload when displayed. Queues, HUD layout and login are kept.

modernmusic.auth.title: NetEase account

modernmusic.auth.qr_missing_cookie: Phone authorization returned no valid credential. Refresh the QR code or use Cookie sign-in.
modernmusic.auth.qr_network_retry: Temporarily unable to check QR status. Retrying; keep this page open.
modernmusic.auth.cookie_help: Paste a Cookie header or full JSON export. NetEase login fields such as MUSIC_U are extracted automatically. You can remember the login.
modernmusic.auth.unlock_help: Remembered accounts restore automatically without a passphrase, QR code or SMS. Retry or delete local login data here.
modernmusic.auth.guest: Guest mode. Sign in and select Remember login for automatic restore.
modernmusic.auth.qr_waiting: Waiting for a scan. Use the phone app shown beside the code.
modernmusic.auth.qr_confirm: Scanned. Confirm sign-in in your phone app.
modernmusic.auth.qr_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled on your phone. Request a new QR code.
modernmusic.auth.qr_unavailable: This QR method is unavailable for the selected platform.
modernmusic.auth.invalid_response: The sign-in service returned an unexpected response. Please retry.

modernmusic.auth.qr_security_verificatio: NetEase requires browser security verification (8821). Polling is paused.
modernmusic.auth.qr_security_help: Open verification, complete it yourself, then continue. You can also switch to SMS sign-in.
modernmusic.auth.qr_security_no_link: NetEase supplied no supported verification link. Waiting cannot complete this step. Use SMS or import a cookie from the official website.
modernmusic.auth.qr_expired: QR code expired. Request a new one.
modernmusic.auth.qr_help: Scan with the NetEase Music app and confirm sign-in on this computer. Closing this page cancels the attempt. Codes last at most two minutes.
modernmusic.auth.qr_error: Could not generate the QR code. Please retry.
modernmusic.auth.invalid_cookie: No valid cookies for this platform, malformed import, or conflicting values. Sign in on the official site and export Cookie / JSON again.
modernmusic.auth.signed_in: Account verified. New songs use this account's available access.
modernmusic.auth.memory_help: Session only. Remember login restores next launch. Account changes stop playback and keep local queues.

modernmusic.auth.logged_out: Signed out and deleted login data. Playback stopped; local queues remain.

modernmusic.hud.lyric_style_help: Click to cycle regular, bold, italic and bold italic. Applies to lyrics and translations.
modernmusic.hud.font_help: The smooth font follows the actual display scale, using the pixel font at 1x. Music menus fit the window automatically; the HUD follows the game GUI scale. Cancel reverts it.
modernmusic.theme.title: Appearance
modernmusic.theme.adaptive.help: The accent and the light behind the player take the current cover's main color and blend when the song changes.
modernmusic.theme.midnight.help: Deep indigo and periwinkle for late-night listening.
modernmusic.theme.daylight.help: A bright light interface with a raspberry accent. HUD text over the world stays light.
modernmusic.theme.mint.help: White cards with fresh leaf green and a soft mint glow above the player. HUD text over the world stays light.
modernmusic.theme.oreui.help: Bedrock Edition OreUI style: square frames, raised buttons, green primary actions and pixel icons.
modernmusic.theme.create.help: Create's workshop: a brass name plate, dithered wood casing, sunken andesite wells, bevelled gray buttons that turn blue, brass plates and rails.
modernmusic.theme.ae2.help: Applied Energistics 2 terminals: lavender-gray panels, slate buttons that sink sky blue, a dark terminal field and fluix purple where things are lit.
modernmusic.theme.ars_nouveau.help: An Ars Nouveau spell book: a gilded cover around parchment, curled tan rules, purple tabs, a mana gauge and a gold coin knob.
modernmusic.theme.astral_sorcery.help: Astral Sorcery's altars and journal: white marble around a night sky, obsidian inlays with gold star studs, starlight rails and celestial blue actions.

modernmusic.shared.title: Playback account source
modernmusic.shared.keep_login_help: Remember this platform for this server and automatically use its shared account when available on your next visit. Unchecking keeps the current listening session.
modernmusic.shared.ready: Server account available. No local login needed.
modernmusic.shared.unavailable: This server does not provide compatible Modern Music shared playback, or the connection is not ready. Personal music and login are still available.
modernmusic.shared.help: Applies to personal, group and FTB listening. Keep signed in to automatically use this server's shared account on your next visit. Switching stops personal playback and resyncs rooms. Playlists and lyrics still use your local provider.
modernmusic.shared.security_notice: Use servers you trust. Song IDs go to the server; switching sources does not upload your local cookie.
modernmusic.admin.security_notice: Use a separate account. Host admins can use saved credentials; unencrypted connections may expose cookies and login QR codes. Encryption is recommended.
